secrets.name: AIS_FEED_HOST
secrets.description: Hostname of the external AIS TCP feed (provided separately for this assessment). Without it the map shows no vessels.

secrets.name: AIS_FEED_PORT
secrets.description: Port of the external AIS TCP feed.

secrets.name: AISSTREAM_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for aisstream.io WebSocket — used to enrich vessels with ship names. Get it at https://www.aisstream.io/ (free signup). Without it, vessel name lookups are disabled.

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase Web API Key. Find it in Firebase Console → Project Settings → General → Web apps. Enable Email/Password sign-in under Authentication → Sign-in method.

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Firebase Auth domain, e.g. your-project.firebaseapp.com. From Firebase Console → Project Settings → General → Web apps.

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Project ID. From Firebase Console → Project Settings → General.

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase App ID. From Firebase Console → Project Settings → General → Web apps.

secrets.name: VITE_POSTHOG_KEY
secrets.description: PostHog project API key. Find it at https://app.posthog.com/project/settings. Without it, analytics tracking is disabled.

secrets.name: VITE_POSTHOG_HOST
secrets.description: PostHog host (https://us.i.posthog.com for US cloud, https://eu.i.posthog.com for EU cloud). Defaults to US cloud if not set.
